content:
<!-- B"H
Boruch Hashem
Blessed is He

The Awtsmoos is beyond every border, yet reveals beauty through each vessel in measure; Awtsmoos.com can feel like one living cinematic field where controls appear as needed and then dissolve back into treasure.
-->
# Chesed Pass — Every Better Possibility

The user wants the interface better still. The next level is not more controls or more decoration. It is stronger choreography.

Possibilities:
- Reduce the visual count of separate boxes by letting adjacent sections share one ambient glass field.
- Make Prompt + Mode feel like one continuous command deck with a subtle internal seam instead of separate cards.
- Introduce a low-cost aurora depth layer behind the command deck using pseudo-elements and transformed gradients.
- Add focus-responsive glass: prompt focus wakes the edge-light; idle surfaces become quieter.
- Use tiny status glyphs and concise labels instead of explanatory sentences where meaning is obvious.
- Turn quick-start templates into cinematic “capsules” with one-line labels and soft moving preview light, not cards.
- Make mode buttons feel like physical tabs cut into glass rather than generic segmented controls.
- Add a single action-path progress whisper: Prompt → Guide → Generate, but avoid a literal wizard.
- Reduce top-level vertical gaps so the first screen shows more of the action path.
- Allow optional panels to visually recede to near-background until opened.
- Give Generate a stronger “ignition” treatment when ready and a calmer locked treatment when provider is unavailable.
- Improve bottom nav with a thin active light rail and less text/visual noise.
- Add touch feedback that uses transform and luminance, never layout-heavy animation.
- Add a very subtle perspective sheen following focus state, not mouse tracking.
- Keep motion off under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- Preserve every current working selector and API behavior.

Ideal result: one black-glass film console, not a dashboard. Calm, fast, obvious, futuristic.
